description:
👋 Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️

We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻

📝 Overview

Sitemate's mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world. The engineers and trades who build our roads, bridges and energy lose hours every week to manual paperwork. We're building AI to free them from that burden, so they can focus on the built world's biggest challenges.

Join our QA team in Nairobi and help drive the shift from manual to automated regression across every product, on web and mobile. You'll write and review automation alongside AI agents that already generate tests on real devices, own release sign-off, and help work out how to test AI products like Storm, whose output changes every time.

Our products move fast and our team spans five continents, so this suits someone proactive and technical who takes ownership, writes clearly, and loves learning new tools.

Employment:

  • Salary:

    • A$60,000 - A$100,000

    • With Sitemate's diverse blend of remote and city-based team members, we ensure fair compensation regardless of your location. Our approach is informed by data sourced from Numbeo, the world’s largest cost-of-living database, which helps us maintain consistent remuneration standards across various regions.

    • Through our Cost of Living Multiplier, based on Numbeo's findings, we provide guidelines for adjusting salaries to reflect the cost of living in different cities. This ensures that all team members enjoy comparable living standards, no matter where they are based

About Sitemate:

Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world.

Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records.

With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture.

Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site.

We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada.

 

Life at Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day.

We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51.

 

Our Core Values

Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate.

  • Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered

  • Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic

  • Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all

  • Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change

  • High Vis: A high visibility, transparent and  open environment

  • Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself

Learn more about our values:

  • Read:

    • On Sitemate's Values, Culture and DNA

  • Listen:

    • Unleashing your Zilla

    • On scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive, performance-based remuneration

  • Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build

  • 20 days paid annual leave, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave

  • Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)

  • Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources

  • Laptop and home office setup budget

  • Flexible work - remote and hybrid options, plus the ability to work from anywhere for several weeks each year

  • Community & Connection - global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions

 

Equal Opportunity

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

 

Learn More About Sitemate

🎧 Podcasts

  • 2026: CRO Lance Hodgson - on why the built world is jumping straight to AI and what that changes

  • 2024: CEO Hartley Pike - on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

  • 2022: CTO Tim Bray - on building quality features that solve real customer problems

💬 Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team: People of Sitemate
⭐ Read what our customers say: G2 Crowd, Trust Radius
🎥 Team Offsites: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

🔧 Day-to-Day

  • Run UAT and exploratory testing on new features and fixes, then release regressions and smoke tests across web and mobile, and give the go/no-go for each release.

  • Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code to drive real devices and browsers through test scenarios, and check what they find before it goes into Jira.

  • Turn Qase test cases into automated tests, and review automated tests written by teammates and AI agents (Playwright for web, WebdriverIO and Appium for mobile).

  • Triage automated regression results each day: separate real bugs from flaky tests and CI or device-cloud problems, and fix the tests.

  • Keep Qase current: write and update test cases so agents can automate them reliably, find coverage gaps from bugs that reach production, and retire outdated cases.

  • Test on real devices and on BrowserStack across iOS and Android versions, including performance.

  • Write clear bug reports with steps to reproduce, severity and evidence, and help run release retros and bug reviews.

  • Plan testing for upcoming features with developers and product, and hand work over across timezones.

⚡ Challenges

  • We're a fast-growing SaaS scale-up becoming AI native. Our products keep changing and new ones keep arriving, so you'll be learning new products, tools and ways of working all the time.

  • We're working out in real time how to test AI products to the same standard as the rest of our products. Storm, our AI data capture agent for frontline construction teams, builds templates and drafts forms from voice notes, photos and text. Its output isn't the same every time, so it needs new ways of testing.

  • There's a lot to cover: several products across web, iOS and Android. You'll learn them by pairing with other QAs.

  • We're a distributed team spread across Europe, Africa, Asia, Australia and the Americas. You'll support and collaborate with engineers across timezones, mostly in writing.

✅ Who This Role is For

  • You take initiative. You spot a gap in quality, raise it, and start fixing it without waiting to be asked.

  • You enjoy technical challenges. You like digging into how things work, writing automation, and figuring out why a test fails.

  • You have a growth mindset. You learn new tools quickly, including AI and coding agents, and you check what they produce rather than trusting it blindly.

  • You like working closely with product and engineers. You'd rather help the team build quality in than catch problems at the end.

  • You take high ownership. You see issues through to resolution and care about the health of the test suite, not just the number of tests.

  • You care about impact. You focus testing on what matters most to customers and the business, and you can explain why.

  • You communicate clearly in writing, so a distributed team can act on your findings.

🚫 Who This Role is Not For

  • Someone new to software testing. You'll need to slot into our current team and processes.

  • Someone new to AI. We need someone who has already used AI to run or assist test automation, and we don't have the capacity to teach that from scratch.

  • Someone who prefers to work heads-down without much communication. This role needs regular, proactive updates across teams and timezones.

🎯 Skills & Tools

Must Have:

  • 2–4 years in software QA, testing web and mobile apps (iOS and Android) on a live commercial product, including on real devices

  • At least 1 year writing and maintaining E2E automation yourself, in any language or framework (e.g. Playwright, WebdriverIO, Appium, Cypress, Selenium), running automatically in CI, with examples of tests you owned end to end

  • Owning suite reliability: diagnosing flaky tests and fixing the cause rather than adding retries

  • Reading and reviewing test code, including code written by AI, well enough to tell whether it actually tests what it claims to

  • Using AI coding agents in QA work (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot) to write, run or maintain tests, at work or in personal projects, and checking their output for false positives and missed bugs

  • Solid testing fundamentals (UAT, regression, exploratory)

  • Clear written bug reports

  • Good communication skills

Nice to Have:

  • Converting manual test cases into automated tests using AI agents

  • Running tests on device farms (e.g. BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm)

  • Mobile automation (WebdriverIO or Appium)

  • Testing AI features, where output isn't the same every time (e.g. evals, golden datasets)

  • API test automation (REST)

  • Performance or load testing

Essential Tools:

  • Test management software (Qase, TestRail or similar)

  • Jira or a similar issue tracker

  • Git and GitHub

  • An AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or similar)

  • GitHub Actions or a similar CI tool

  • A good internet connection

Bonus Tools:

  • BrowserStack or a similar device farm

  • Postman

  • k6 or JMeter

  • Xcode and Android Studio (for simulators, emulators and device logs)

PLEASE Note:

  • We hire directly and don’t work with agencies
